name: Layout switcher
description: The one shared layout switcher every plugin screen uses (qualified name axf.toolbar.layout-switcher; screen-layouts@1, Brett Nov 4 2026). Hidden by default; shown from the screen title's right-click, a setting or voice. Its buttons are the current screen's layouts (the runtime's `screen-layouts` live list), so editing this asset changes the switcher in every plugin at once; a plugin can take its own copy from the toolbar's right-click.
author: AmberX AXF
